properties.qodana.baseline.note: PLACEHOLDER empty-results baseline — J-8 T-15. The local Qodana run on the dev box was OOM-killed (exit 137) during project opening: the qodana-jvm-community linter's IntelliJ indexing of the multi-module Gradle composite build needs ~6-8G of heap and only ~2G was free on the shared LXC box (MaxRAMPercentage=70). So this empty baseline ships as the going-in state and the FIRST `qodana-scan` CI run (a CI runner has the headroom) becomes the baseline-establishing run: with `--baseline qodana.sarif.json` against THIS empty file, every current unused-declaration finding (~605 expected across stacks, scoped here to alpenflight/server main; ~90% false-positive per the J-26 T-33 triage — Spring-Data query params + @ExceptionHandler dispatch params) reports as NEW. ONE-TIME FOLLOW-UP: download the `qodana-sarif-<run_id>` artifact from that first CI run (or read it from the gallery maintainability panel's staged `qodana-report.sarif.json`) and commit it over this file to lock the baseline — thereafter the report gates only on genuinely NEW unused code. The job is REPORT-ONLY (its own workflow, continue-on-error, NOT in ci.yml's required aggregator) so a high first-run NEW count never reds the build.
